summary.text: Eddie Phanichkul is the Democratic candidate for the Wisconsin State Assembly, District 63, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Robert Wittke.
An entrepreneur and small business owner, he serves as membership secretary of the Democratic Party of Milwaukee County, according to a Ballotpedia survey.

paragraphs.text: Eddie Phanichkul earned a high school diploma from Patrick Henry High School and attended Mesa College, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he has owned a bar and restaurant, was on the launch team of Uber in San Diego, and co-founded Skrewball Whiskey.
He said that during the pandemic he co-founded the American Medical Manufactures Association and worked with President Biden's PPE Supply Chain Resilience Work Group.
Phanichkul said he serves on the executive board of the Greendale Chamber of Commerce and is the father of a daughter.
He listed affordability, education and responsible growth as his campaign messages, including fully funding special education and requiring strict guardrails for data centers.
He also said he supports raising the minimum wage and eliminating the tipped minimum wage.
